docs.title: About
docs.text:
House of Quants is an independent quantitative research project by Tomasz Wilczega, CFA.

My work sits between quantitative research, engineering, and implementation: designing systematic strategies and building the infrastructure to research, test, deploy, and run them in production.

The same approach extends to AI-powered systems and automated workflows for research and other complex analytical work.

House of Quants is the public side of that work: a place for research notes, methods, selected tools, and implementation-oriented ideas. Most production code and proprietary research remain private.

docs.title: Research
docs.text:
Longer-form quantitative research and strategy studies.

Each publication should aim to answer a clear question, explain the methodology, show the relevant evidence, and separate robust conclusions from assumptions or open questions.

docs.title: Research template
docs.text:
A typical note can follow this structure:

  1. Research question
  2. Motivation
  3. Data and universe
  4. Methodology
  5. Results
  6. Robustness checks
  7. Implementation considerations
  8. Conclusions
  9. Selected code or notebook, where useful

Research will be added here over time.
